topic: Can geometric programming methods maintain scalability for power allocation in dense multiband satellite networks?
consensus_response: Geometric programming methods can maintain scalability for power allocation in dense multiband satellite networks by convexifying non-convex optimization structures using lower bound exponential slack variables. This approach enables efficient tractable solutions to complex problems, such as sum power minimization and maximization of minimum per-user data rate. However, it may amplify small channel variations, increasing interference between users. To mitigate this effect, the proposed method can be combined with frequency reuse techniques, allowing for more aggressive spectrum reuse while maintaining acceptable levels of interference.
reference_context: Geometric programming methods have been applied to power allocation in dense multiband satellite networks to efficiently solve complex optimization problems. The approach has been validated through numerical results demonstrating its efficiency and scalability.
